shared_elements: animal heads shown in a repeated series
justification: Both surfaces present a vertical, totem-like stacking of beings in which a snarling predator with exposed teeth appears above/among other creatures and a human-like figure is incorporated into the sequence. The biggest difference is the mode of depiction of those beings: A shows massive frontal heads and a body in the round with huge staring eyes, while B shows small profile animals (quadrupeds, a bird with long neck, a fox-like carnivore) in low relief organised into horizontal registers.
